The sun, stars, and moon are a lucky family. Mama, the leaves turned green, when will they bloom? Wait until summer comes, the flowers turn red, can we pick them? Wait until autumn arrives, or if we plant them in the soil, will they sprout? They will grow up, right? The flowers and leaves are also a lucky family's treasures.
